items.difficulty_reason: 5 行证明但理由在案：群胚范畴内 Mor(x,y) 在 Mor(y,y) 作用下为主齐性集，逐 T 点读取即得 pseudo-torsor；无 omit 标记。1 处引用带 canonical tag。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-groupoid-action-stabilizer-pseudo-torsor (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3618-3630

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: in a groupoid category the arrows Mor(x, y) form a principal homogeneous set under the group Mor(y, y); transferring this along T-points gives that the G_0-action on R over U x_S U from the cited stabilizer action is free and transitive wherever nonempty, i.e. R is a pseudo G_0-torsor (source lines 3632-3636)
